title: プロジェクトデザイン実践（実験）(生命・応用バイオ学科)
subtitle: Design Project / Implementing and Operating
courseType: Design Project ProgramDesign Project CoursesDesign Project
educationalGoal:
-To gain skills to verify hypotheses or solution concept with logical approaches.
-To understand phenomena, objects and events quantitatively with high credibility.
-To reliably find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objects, events.
-To deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly.
-To gain basic skills to credibly and smoothly conduct verification activities.
-To have an image of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.
advice:
The students will learn the methodologies required to carry out processes to verify hypotheses; or, the students will learn methodologies to verify the effectiveness/acceptability of a solution concept, or a specific part of the concept.

One is that the students will learn the basic “data-handling skills” needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing → visualization → reporting.
One is that the students will learn “skills to proceed with verification processes” and “elementary skills of verification activities” from setting the hypothesis to its verification.

Students have acquired knowledge of experimental design and data analysis in "Design Project / Introduction". In this class, students make use of this knowledge in experiments to verify ideas. Data-handling skills are extremely important to correctly understand the results. For this purpose, it is necessary to acquire highly accurate experimental techniques. In addition, it is important to have basic academic skills in specialized fields.
Students reconsider a verification plan and perform a verification experiment in this session. It is important to think carefully about the verification process so that it is valid for the given purpose.
PBL is an effective means for enhancing educational effects. It is necessary to understand the contents of PBL well.
requiredKnowledge:
Knowledge of basic chemistry (Analytical chemistry, Organic chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry) and basic life science (Biochemistry, Microbiology, Enzymology, Molecular biology, Organic chemistry).
Highly accurate experimental techniques.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
To be able to find characteristics, features, and laws of phenomena, objects, and events.
To be able to deliver acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
To be able to utilize various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.

achievementLevels.ideal:
1) To proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts.
2) To quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize information.
3) To find and understand features, characteristics, and regularities of corresponding phenomena, objects, and events.
4) To communicate acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
5) To smoothly conduct verification activities.
6) To become aware of your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers.
achievementLevels.standard:
1) To proceed with verification processes for hypotheses and solution concepts with guidance.
2) To quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events and organize the information with guidance from the instructor.
3) To find and understand characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, etc., with guidance.
4) To share acquired information to third person.
5) To smoothly conduct verification activities with guidance from the instructor.
6) To recognize your specialties and imagine the technological fields and engineers with guidance.
